claims: Timothée Chalamet faced backlash in February 2026 for saying he didn't want to work in "ballet or opera" because "no one cares about this anymore".
Timothée Chalamet’s comments were made during a discussion with Matthew McConaughey.

Chalamet stated "I don't want to be working in ballet or opera, or, you know, things where it's like, 'Hey, keep this thing alive, even though it's like, no one cares about this anymore'" while discussing movie theater relevance.
The Metropolitan Opera criticized the remark.
The Royal Ballet and Opera criticized the remark.
The Metropolitan Opera and the Royal Ballet and Opera noted that thousands still attend their performances.
Chalamet’s mother and grandmother were professional dancers, according to The Guardian.
Timothée Chalamet grew up backstage at the New York City Ballet, according to The Guardian.
The comments were joked about at the 2026 Oscars.
Misty Copeland publicly rebuked Timothée Chalamet, according to USA Today.
The Seattle Opera offered a 14% discount using the promo code "TIMOTHEE", as reported by The Guardian.
The 14% discount represented the 14 cents Chalamet joked he lost in viewership.
Timothée Chalamet joked he lost 14 cents in viewership.
